intent.description: 将电子书通过 Wi-Fi 发送到已配对的 Kindle，兼容 KOReader 与原生接收端；安装或更新 KOReader 和插件后，从 Kindle 本机逐文件校验 SHA-256。用户说“发到 Kindle”“Send this ebook to Kindle”“更新 Kindle 的 KOReader 插件”“检查 Kindle 文件完整性”或点名 qiaomu-send2kindle 时使用。需要找书或下载时先用乔木电子书 MCP。仅找书、仅下载、解释 Kindle、越狱、刷固件和邮件 Send to Kindle 不属于此 skill。
intent.job_to_be_done: Deliver requested ebooks and maintain KOReader/plugin packages with verified Kindle-native installation integrity.
target_users: Owners of paired jailbroken Kindle devices, with or without Obsidian
inputs: Book title and optional author, language or edition
Or an explicit local ebook path
Physically paired device and unlocked OS credential storage
Installable KOReader/plugin ZIP and its publisher or trusted frozen-build SHA-256
outputs: Verified Kindle documents path, byte count and SHA256
Original source digest and explicit native scan state
Actionable failure without a false success claim
Kindle-native SHA-256 result, verified file count, rollback state and identity-bound installation baseline
exclusions: Silent key export or passwordless login
Only finding or downloading without device delivery

should_trigger: 下载《道德经》并发到 Kindle
把这本 EPUB 传到 Kindle
用 qiaomu-send2kindle 给 Kindle 传书
更新 Kindle 的 KOReader 插件并校验
安装 Kindle 上的 KOReader 插件
检查 Kindle 文件完整性
should_not_trigger: 下载这本书，不要发送到 Kindle
near_neighbor: 只解释 Kindle 怎么用
我的 Kindle 不能开机

permissions.network: explicit ebook MCP download, paired private-LAN Kindle, checksum-pinned packages and receiver preparation
permissions.file_write: requested downloads, machine device metadata/runtime, explicitly selected USB public pairing/settings, requested KOReader/plugin package installation with verified backups
permissions.subprocess: isolated Python dependencies and fixed bundled Node converter and fixed Kindle-native checksum program; no untrusted shell interpolation
permissions.secrets: native OS credential backend only; in-memory auth; no vault, argv, log, file export or plaintext fallback

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
